usage: The word '外公' (ngoi6 gung1) refers to a maternal grandfather, meaning your mother's father.
'外公' is a noun used to specifically denote the grandfather on your mother's side, different from paternal grandfathers.
You can use '外公' when talking about family members in a casual or formal context.
It is common to address or refer to your mother's father simply as '外公' in Cantonese-speaking families.
When introducing family members, '外公' helps clarify the relationship is on the maternal side.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 sing1 kei4 jat6 heoi3 taam3 ngoi6 gung1.
examples.meaning: I am going to visit my maternal grandpa on Sunday.

ngoi6 gung1 sung3 zo2 ngo5 jat1 fan6 lai5 mat6.
examples.meaning: Maternal grandpa gave me a gift.
